preliminaryReason: JavaScript-side measurement under react-test-renderer on a host machine. No physical device or native display timing.
notMeasured: Native display timing (time until pixels are drawn) — needs a simulator or device build
Scenario F: FlatList scrolling and frame timing — needs a native list on device
Unistyles, all scenarios — needs its native runtime (simulator or device build)
Bundle size, native binary size, build time — see README.md
Native memory — JS heap only; no platform profiler
Style-resolution time and allocation counts — not instrumented in this harness

definitions.hostRerenders: Host View/Text nodes whose props object is new after a commit. Comparable across libraries because all render the same host tree.
definitions.cardInvocations: BenchmarkCard function calls. NOT comparable across libraries for context-driven updates (Vajra and Tamagui read the theme inside children).

host.device: host machine (no physical device used; JS-side measurement)
